questions.question: Samuel told Israel to return to the LORD with all their hearts. What did he say they must put away?

answers.text: The weapons of their fighting men
The gold from the guilt offering

questions.question: When the Philistine rulers marched against Israel, what did the frightened Israelites ask Samuel to do?

answers.text: Keep crying out to the LORD for them
Make peace with the Philistine rulers
Carry the ark out into the battle

questions.question: When the Philistines came near to fight Israel at Mizpah, what did the LORD do?

answers.text: He thundered loudly against the Philistines
He told Israel to make peace with them
He told Samuel to stop the offering

questions.question: After the LORD helped Israel defeat the Philistines, what name did Samuel give the stone he set up?
